summary: ⚠️ CRITICAL FLOOD RISK — This home sits in a 10–20 m statutory flood zone beside the Chikuma River. At that depth, a 2-storey house is completely submerged: the second floor is NOT a refuge. Yoshiko (78, bad knees, no smartphone) lives alone and will need 3× the normal walking time to reach safety. The nearest flood-safe shelter is 北部スポーツ・レクリエーションパーク at 2.63 km — walking that distance with impaired mobility is extremely challenging without assistance. Kenji and Mika must arrange a support person to accompany Yoshiko at the first sign of a Chikuma River flood warning. The closest facilities (穂保高台避難公園 at 0.61 km, 長沼小学校 at 0.64 km) are NOT flood-designated — going there during a flood could be fatal. For typhoon season: act on Level 3 Evacuation Preparation alert or earlier; do not wait for Level 4 or 5.
caveats: Shelter data is registered by municipalities and may not reflect the latest designations; confirm with 長野市 for critical decisions (GSI terms of use).
Hazard depths are from the largest-scale statutory inundation scenario (想定最大規模) per MLIT specification — actual event depth may be lower, but planning must assume the statutory maximum.
JMA warning area code 2020111/2020112 is ambiguous for this address; monitor both 長野市長野 area feeds during typhoon events.
Distances are straight-line; actual walking routes may be longer. With Yoshiko's mobility needs, route reconnaissance in calm conditions is strongly recommended.
This assessment reflects data retrieved on 2026-08-24 and should be reviewed after each municipal hazard-map update cycle.
